Include dynamic uncertainty (history match) in DG3 forecast.

risks.name: Drogon - Porosity and cementation uncertainty (ESCALATED at DG2)
risks.description: Porosity revised 0.18→0.14 based on core data. STOIIP reduced 8%. Now the dominant volume uncertainty driver. Severity escalated Medium→High.
risks.mitigation: CentralFlanks core (3 wells) before DG3. Condition for gate passage.

risks.name: Drogon - Fault compartmentalization (MITIGATED at DG2)
risks.description: 4D seismic confirms pressure communication across NE boundary fault. Risk downgraded High→Low. No longer a development constraint.
risks.mitigation: Confirmed via 4D seismic reprocessing (2026-04-15). No further action required.

risks.name: Drogon - Early water breakthrough (SouthWing)
risks.description: High water cut risk in SouthWing segment due to thin oil column (8m) and proximity to OWC. Could reduce segment recovery by 30–50%. Impact on field plateau duration.
risks.mitigation: Rate-controlled production in SouthWing; down-dip perforations; monitor with downhole gauges. Consider WAG if water cut exceeds 60%.

risks.name: Drogon - Subsea tieback distance (12 km)
risks.description: Long subsea tieback introduces flow assurance risks (hydrates, wax, slugging) and higher CAPEX. Pipeline routing across uneven seabed terrain may add 15–20% to flowline cost.
risks.mitigation: Insulated flowline with MEG injection; thermal simulation for steady-state and shutdown; pipeline routing study (geotechnical survey Q3 2026).
